{
  "literal": "ساعة السعادة: مشروبان بسعر واحد من الساعة 5 إلى 7 مساءً",
  "adaptation": "عرض خاص: مشروبان بسعر واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً",
  "back_translation": "Special offer: two drinks for the price of one from 5 to 7 PM",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "Avoided the term 'happy hour' because it is widely associated with alcohol, which is culturally and legally impermissible in Saudi Arabia; all drinks are understood to be non-alcoholic."
}
literal: ساعة السعادة: مشروبان بسعر واحد من الساعة 5 إلى 7 مساءً
adaptation: عرض خاص: مشروبان بسعر واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً
back_translation: Special offer: two drinks for the price of one from 5 to 7 PM
notes: Avoided the term 'happy hour' because it is widely associated with alcohol, which is culturally and legally impermissible in Saudi Arabia; all drinks are understood to be non-alcoholic.
